headline: Revenue and profit growth accelerate; guidance raised
summary_short: Allegion reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1,151.5 million, up 12.7% y/y and 11.4% q/q, with diluted EPS of $2.15, up 16.2% y/y on margin expansion led by the Americas segment.
summary_long: Revenue rose 12.7% y/y (11.4% q/q) to $1,151.5M, with organic growth of 6.9% led by the Americas; acquisitions added a 5.1% tailwind. Operating margin expanded to 22.1% from 21.5% (adjusted margin 24.2% vs 23.7%), driving operating income up 15.9% y/y to $254.7M. Net income rose 15.6% y/y to $184.6M; diluted EPS of $2.15 was up 16.2% y/y (adjusted EPS $2.40, +17.6%). Cash fell to $320.6M from $656.8M a year ago after $120M of buybacks and continued debt-funded M&A. Management raised full-year 2026 guidance for reported revenue growth (7.5-8.5%), organic growth (3.5-4.5%), and adjusted EPS ($8.85-$9.00).

drivers.explanation: Organic growth of 6.9% (Americas volume and price realization) plus a 5.1% net acquisitions/divestitures contribution and 0.7% FX tailwind; International organic revenue fell 1.2% on weaker European demand.

Adjusted operating margin gained on favorable volume leverage and price/productivity net of inflation, including a currency tailwind; Americas margin rose 20bp while International margin fell 70bp on volume declines.
EPS growth outpaced revenue on operating leverage and a lower effective tax rate (19.0% vs 20.3%); adjusted EPS of $2.40 rose 17.6% after excluding restructuring, M&A, and amortization costs.
Net income growth tracked operating income, partly offset by a swing to $2.0M of other expense from a non-cash pension settlement charge versus other income a year ago.
Management raised full-year 2026 guidance for revenue growth, organic growth, and adjusted EPS, citing sustained Americas non-residential strength and cost discipline amid softer European demand.
